newsitem.title: CHINA: Shenzhen B shares close down on A share losses.
newsitem.headline: Shenzhen B shares close down on A share losses.

text.p: Shenzhen's hard currency B share index closed lower on Wednesday as a result of declines in the domestic A share market, analysts said.
The B share index lost 1.49 points or 1.13 percent to 129.96 on turnover of HK$46 million against HK$34 million on Tuesday.
The A share index was trimmed by 9.71 points or 2.35 percent to 403.52 on turnover of 4.0 billion yuan against 4.1 billion yuan in the previous session.
"The fall in B shares were mainly fuelled by the weakness of A shares," an analyst at China Guotai Securities said. He ruled out steep falls in the B share market in the short term.
